accepted.sentence: A face frame may use vertical stiles and horizontal rails to reinforce the front and provide mounting surfaces for doors.
Some door panels contain glass held in place by narrow wooden or metal retaining strips.
Pull-out drawers commonly consist of a box-shaped body that travels on side-mounted or under-mounted runners.
A small lock may be fitted to a door, with its bolt engaging a strike plate on the frame.
Exterior surfaces may be covered with paint, clear varnish, laminate, or thin decorative veneer.
Corner joints such as dowels, screws, or interlocking cuts connect panels and help keep the frame square.
Ventilation openings in a door or rear panel allow air to circulate through the enclosed space.
A projecting top can provide a flat work surface, with its edges sometimes rounded or capped for protection.
